decision: Retain the candidate with actual five-collector coexistence and independent requested-row/receipt accounting. Finish the exact running archived replay and broader regression. Next fix and qualify the reproduced full-day research relay frame limit before whole-study or operational claims.
falsifier: An unavailable inserted/refreshed observation, original normalization mismatch, missing raw/authorization bypass, erased original obligation, source/identity corruption accepted on reopen, or disagreement in archived reproduction updates or falsifies the corresponding claim.
hypothesis: Durable service availability enforcement must preserve each actual frozen producer runtime and remain effective when its store recovers orphan raw files.
limitations: Synthetic responses and a roughly 30-minute initial history do not qualify full-day source history, real network conditions, live-IP headroom, venue charges or economic benefit.
